Despite him clearly being unwell and experiencing what we now know was a serious reaction, the practice refused to see him and told him to “wait.” As a result, I was left with no option but to call an ambulance.

My father has now been admitted to hospital.

This is not the first time concerns have been dismissed, and it is unacceptable that a patient has to deteriorate to the point of hospital admission because their GP surgery will not assess them. GPs are meant to provide early care — not force families to rely on emergency services when help is refused.

The stress, fear, and risk caused by this repeated lack of care is enormous. Patients and families deserve far better than
